name: control-redbase
comment: Harness positive control (not one of the 8 decisions): start RED_BASE detuned to 1541 (1.5x its 1027 default, a known-bad ~+50%-reduction-offset detune) and verify SPSA walks it BACK toward default. If it cannot recover a deliberate detune, flat campaign results are harness insensitivity, not flat landscapes. Single param so the whole gradient budget concentrates on it.
